name: PASI Engineering Workspace roadmap
cross_cutting_contracts: Active browser tab/controller identity is durable execution identity; conversation URLs are metadata.
CDP Fetch response interception and response streaming are authoritative for ChatGPT generation transport.
CDP Accessibility/Input is the browser interaction boundary; DOM is diagnostic, not authoritative transport/state.
Durable operation ledger is authoritative; network observations feed correlation/classification.
At most one operation is dispatchable; stale queued/claimed operations must be reconciled or quarantined before resume.
P0.4 is a supervisor-owned seven-day gate, not a model coding task.
Reuse the authenticated ChatGPT session; new chat only on verified context exhaustion; usage limits are blocked states.
Architecture changes during acceptance require explicit evidence and must not silently replace the system under test.
Passing tests without repository progress, commit/PR evidence, and provenance is not task completion.
Protected supervisory core is immutable from agent self-editing; mutable skills/tools use shadow verification and atomic promotion/rollback.

phases.title: Runtime proof and delivery infrastructure
phases.notes: P0.4 remains active until the full 168-hour supervisor window closes with evidence.

phases.title: Control-plane consolidation
phases.notes: Includes protected-core/mutable-skill boundaries, shadow self-modification, multi-agent orchestration, persistent automation gateway, and change-aware verification.

phases.title: Planner, scheduler, and engineering memory
phases.notes: Includes procedural skills, guarded skill adaptation, cross-session memory, persistent scheduling, and asynchronous gateway integrations.

phases.title: Typed computer integration
phases.notes: Includes stable browser-tab identity and browser-session continuity; computer use stays behind typed capability, authorization, resource, and recovery boundaries.
